goal: Close all remaining integration blockers by end of 2026-02-24 local workspace time: deployment proof, Android device E2E proof, gateway timeout root-cause resolution, and strict-gate-ready CT decision evidence.

inputs.description: Latest policy decisions and blocked reasons.

constraints.notes: Approval-required operations (deploy/schema change/permission elevation/destructive commands) must be explicitly approved by User before execution.

acceptance: Backend deploy, secrets-sync, and restart evidence is attached with sanitized command logs.
Android device runtime E2E evidence covers bearer first load, cookie follow-up, 401/403 UX, and lifecycle stability.
Gateway /gateway/universe_3d timeout root cause is identified with mitigation evidence or fixed behavior proof.
Strict gate evidence is attached and CT final decision is recorded as accept or blocked with canonical handoff JSON.

risk.note: Any missing runtime/deploy evidence keeps delivery blocked even if local tests pass.

next_actions: Dispatch worker-specific cycle02 tasks with end-of-day deadline.
Collect backend/android/frontend result artifacts with exact commands, exits, and evidence paths.
Run strict gate and publish final CT result plus canonical handoff JSON.

metadata.deadline_note: Finish by end of 2026-02-24 local workspace time.

runtime_venv_policy.default_root_rule: If LIFE_VENV_ROOT is unset, use $env:USERPROFILE\.venvs_hub (fallback C:\venvs_hub for non-ASCII profile environments).
runtime_venv_policy.log_notation: Always record resolved venv root and canonical venv name in docs/logs.

device E2E evidence for bearer->cookie, 401/403 UX, lifecycle
